title: The Other Side of Boredom
logline: There is a world of rapture on the other side of boredom.
desc: A single-shot film documenting an unremarkable morning jog becomes a history of our species and a touching personal skirmish with the truth of ageing. A single-shot, zero-budget experimental documentary by a 53-year-old first-time film maker. Go figure.
